title: Dead parameter in BBCode img region tag
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.0.stable.flathub
after noticing this i updated to
v4.6.1.stable.flathub [14d19694e]
and the issue persists.

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable (14d19694e) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (nvidia) - AMD Ryzen 7 2700X Eight-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.28 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have a horizontal texture atlas, like a strip of images in the same png file. I wanted to utilize the region parameter of the img tag to get a certain cell of the atlas as inline image in text like so:
`[img region="(0, 0, 64, 64)" width=120 height=120]res://file.png[/img]`
that works. 
However, when I want to get the next tile at (64, 0, 64, 64), it turns out the x-parameter in those brackets is completely ignored and treated as 0 regardless of input. so even something like 
`[img region="(Hello World lmao, 0, 64, 64)" width=120 height=120]res://file.png[/img]` does the same as (0, 0, 64, 64).

### Steps to reproduce

in a new richtextlabel, enable bbcode and paste the following:
```
[img region="(0, 0, 64, 64)" width=120 height=120]res://icon.svg[/img] This works as expected.
[img region="(64, 0, 64, 64)" width=120 height=120]res://icon.svg[/img] This doesn't.
[img region="(See you at GodotCon, 0, 64, 64)" width=120 height=120]res://icon.svg[/img] At all.
[img region="(64,0,64,64)" width=120 height=120]res://icon.svg[/img] Omitting space characters in the parenthesis doesn't change anything (i like that actually)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This can be done in any scene in any project on the fly with a fresh richtextlabel.
